card.name: Semicolons separating clauses or cross-references
card.fires_on: The semicolon character, mainly when it ends a clause or sits inside a bracketed cross-reference such as 'see WARNINGS;'. It also appears in lists of references or terms.

modes.label: Semicolon in label cross-references
modes.description: A semicolon after a section name inside a see-also reference in drug label text.
modes.example: see WARNINGS<< ;>> Fetal Toxicity ). Data Human Data

modes.label: Semicolon between prose clauses
modes.description: A semicolon joining two clauses in general web prose, often right after a sentence-like clause.

modes.label: Semicolon in citation or term lists
modes.description: A semicolon separating names, citations or terms in a list.
